fields.title: Payment SDK upgraded to 5.2 for the new card network rules / 支付 SDK 升级到 5.2，适配新的卡组织规则
fields.author: Leo Chen / 陈立
fields.verification: Staging payments with three test cards. / 在预发环境用三张测试卡完成支付。

fields.title: Failed payment webhooks now retry for up to 24 hours / 支付失败回调现在会自动重试最多 24 小时
fields.author: Codex (agent), reviewed by Noah Wang / Codex（Agent），王诺评审
fields.verification: Integration test kills the receiver for 10 minutes; the order is delivered on retry. / 集成测试让接收端停机 10 分钟，重试后订单送达。

fields.title: Shoppers can apply a coupon code at checkout / 用户可以在结算页填写优惠码
fields.author: Claude Code (agent), reviewed by Leo Chen / Claude Code（Agent），陈立评审
fields.verification: Unit tests plus a staging run: a valid code takes 10% off, an expired code shows the reason. / 单元测试加预发实测：有效码减 10%，过期码显示原因。

fields.title: Paid orders now produce a PDF invoice with tax per line / 已付款订单现在会生成逐行列税的 PDF 发票
fields.author: Noah Wang / 王诺
fields.verification: Golden-file tests for three tax regions. / 覆盖三个税区的基准文件测试。

fields.title: Tapping Pay repeatedly no longer creates duplicate orders / 连续点「支付」不再生成重复订单
fields.author: Claude Code (agent), reviewed by Leo Chen / Claude Code（Agent），陈立评审
fields.verification: Reproduced with five rapid taps before the fix; one order after it, on iOS and Android. / 修复前连点五次可复现；修复后 iOS 和 Android 都只生成一笔。

fields.title: Invoice PDFs show the company tax ID / 发票 PDF 显示公司税号
fields.author: Noah Wang / 王诺
fields.verification: Golden-file test updated; checked one PDF per legal entity. / 更新基准文件测试；每个法人主体各核对一份 PDF。

fields.title: API docs cover the new invoice endpoints / API 文档补充了新的发票接口
fields.author: Codex (agent) / Codex（Agent）
fields.verification: Docs build passes; examples run against staging. / 文档构建通过；示例在预发环境跑通。

fields.title: A coupon code stays filled in after the page refreshes / 刷新页面后已填的优惠码不会丢
fields.author: Claude Code (agent), reviewed by Leo Chen / Claude Code（Agent），陈立评审
fields.verification: Browser test: fill a code, reload, the code and discount are still there. / 浏览器测试：填码、刷新，码和折扣都还在。

fields.title: Store staff can export the order list to CSV / 门店人员可以把订单列表导出为 CSV
fields.author: Claude Code (agent), reviewed by Ava Liu / Claude Code（Agent），刘安娃评审
fields.verification: Exported 200 filtered orders; row count and totals match the screen. / 导出 200 条筛选后的订单，行数和合计与页面一致。

fields.title: Order times now show in the store's local time zone / 订单时间现在按门店所在时区显示
fields.author: Claude Code (agent), reviewed by Ava Liu / Claude Code（Agent），刘安娃评审
fields.verification: Checked one order from Shanghai and one from Singapore against the database timestamp. / 用上海和新加坡各一笔订单对照数据库时间核对。

fields.title: Product search on mobile returns results twice as fast / 手机端商品搜索速度提升一倍
fields.author: Iris Zhou / 周艾
fields.verification: p95 search latency on staging fell from 820 ms to 390 ms. / 预发环境搜索 p95 延迟从 820 ms 降到 390 ms。

fields.title: Order details show a status timeline / 订单详情页显示状态时间线
fields.author: Claude Code (agent), reviewed by Ava Liu / Claude Code（Agent），刘安娃评审
fields.verification: Checked five shipped orders against their status history. / 对照状态历史核对了五笔已发货订单。
